requirements.title: VALUES receives bounded date/time integers or -HUGE sentinels
requirements.definition: The first eight VALUES elements receive year/month/day/UTC-offset/hour/minute/second/millisecond values as specified, or -HUGE(VALUES) when the corresponding information is unavailable.

pending.values-date-elements-or-negative-huge: Initialize VALUES to a non-default sentinel such as 123456789. Assert VALUES(1:3) are either all -HUGE(VALUES) for unavailable date information or year/month/day values with month 1..12 and day 1..31; do not assert a current date.
pending.values-time-elements-or-negative-huge: Assert VALUES(5:8) are either unavailable sentinels where permitted or within 0..23, 0..59, 0..60, and 0..999 respectively; do not assert a current time.
pending.values-zone-element-or-negative-huge: Assert VALUES(4) is either -HUGE(VALUES) or an integer minute offset. Do not compare it to a local timezone or require consistency with ZONE beyond each argument's own bounded form rule.

requirements.definition: Date, clock, and time zone information might be available on some images and not others; if available on more than one image, whether images share the same information is processor dependent.

pending.date-time-multi-image-sharing-processor-: OUT OF SCOPE for single-image fixtures and also processor dependent; no portable oracle may require shared or distinct multi-image clock data.
